# UnifiedQR

> Free QR Code generator and tracker. Create, customize, download and manage QR codes for URLs, PDFs, contacts, SMS, email, WiFi and more.

## What is UnifiedQR?

UnifiedQR is a web application that lets users create, customize, track and manage QR codes — both static and dynamic — entirely for free. It supports URL, PDF, multi-URL, vCard contact, plain text, app store link, SMS, email, phone call and social media QR code types.

## Key Features

- Free QR code generation with no watermarks, no sign-up required
- 13 customizable QR code templates with color and style options
- Static codes (permanent data) and dynamic codes (editable destination + analytics)
- Download as PNG or SVG in any resolution
- Dynamic codes support real-time scan tracking with device, referrer and geo data
- Team collaboration — invite members, share QR code libraries
- CSV bulk import for batch QR code creation
- QR code short links (qr.nxtgensec.org/r/slug) for print and marketing
- Multi-language support — 40 languages with automatic detection

## Pricing

- Free: Unlimited static QR codes, 2 dynamic codes, basic analytics
- Flex: ₹749/mo — 25 dynamic codes, team collaboration, priority support
- Pro: ₹2,999/mo — Unlimited dynamic codes, unlimited team members, full analytics

## Technology

- Built with TanStack Start (SSR), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Supabase for authentication, database and realtime
- Cashfree for payment processing (INR)
